name: Avocado Oil
siboNotes: Pure avocado oil is well-tolerated for SIBO as it contains no fermentable carbohydrates and provides healthy fats for nutrient absorption.
preparationTips: Use for high-heat cooking due to its high smoke point (520°F)
Store in a cool, dark place to maintain quality and prevent rancidity
Choose cold-pressed varieties for maximum nutritional benefits
Great for salad dressings and marinades
pairsWellWith: Roasted vegetables like zucchini and bell peppers
Green salads with spinach and cucumber
Low-FODMAP herbs like basil and oregano
nutritionalHighlights: Rich in monounsaturated fats, particularly oleic acid
High in vitamin E and antioxidants
